prompt.title: Audit your results and capacity
prompt.text: Every asset you rely on — your body, your money, your relationships — produces results only as long as you also maintain it. Rate a few assets in each group on how much you're getting out of them right now and how much you're putting back in, and name one maintenance action for anything over-used.
prompt.glossText: Over-used: you get a lot out of it and put little back.
prompt.whyItMatters: Chasing results while skipping maintenance works for a while, then the asset stops producing altogether. Naming the trade-off on purpose is what makes it possible to rebalance before that happens.

history.empty: No audits yet. Start your first one.

form.actionLabel: Name one thing you'll do to maintain it.
form.actionRequired: Name one maintenance action for this over-used asset.
form.actionPlaceholder: e.g. A 20-minute walk before work, three days a week.
form.reflectionPlaceholder: e.g. I've been living off my savings and my sleep. This month I'll put some back into both.
form.legend: Getting out: how much you rely on it now · Putting in: how much you maintain it.
form.duplicateAsset: That asset is already in this audit.
form.removeConfirmBody: Its ratings and maintenance action will be lost. You can undo this for a few seconds after removing it.

statusGloss.overUsed: you get a lot out of it and put little back.
statusGloss.balanced: what you get out of it and what you put in are about even.
statusGloss.underUsed: you put in more than you get out of it right now.

checklist.named: Add an asset and name every one
checklist.actions: Name a maintenance action for any over-used asset
